limitations.note: The OR corrected the duty cycle, but replacing the falling-edge counter decode with a delayed copy of clkp shifted both output edges half an input cycle later than the minimal fix.
The test required the rewritten divider's rising-edge phase instead of checking that the original counter-based phase was preserved, so it passed the timing change that caused the mismatch.
A separate edit corrected even-divisor behavior introduced by the rewrite, which was unnecessary to fix the requested divide-by-7 circuit.
